releases.name: My Mart
releases.summary: Featured on "AppsGoneFree!"The object is simple: place gems on a board with 64 tiles and 8 colors so that the numbers of gems in each column and row match the numbers on the top and side of the board. You've heard this before? Well, there's one more tiny detail; every color must contain exactly four gems. There are hundreds of puzzle games that rely on the number three. You know what's better than three? Four! It's one better! TapGem presents you with 60 puzzles of varying difficulty, providing hours of fun, challenge, and addiction.  Want more? Download an additional 60 puzzles! As you progress to the harder levels, don't be surprised if you start pulling out your hair.

releases.name: Flowstone Saga
releases.summary:
In the sleepy backwaters of Ocean's End, a young adventurer and her stalwart pet Sprig stumble on an ancient power hidden beneath long-forgotten ruins. With it, Mirai can harness the power to repair, build, and... fight.

Mirai will use these new powers to help build her home of New Riverstone, face growing threats like the Scarlet Tusk Pirates and Byzankar Empire, hunt for treasure across mountains, forests, temples, and ruins, and forge new friendships with people (and animals) across the world. Perhaps, the secrets of her past will finally be revealed as well...

Master a totally unique puzzle-battle system in this 16-bit, JRPG-inspired adventure featuring an epic story, charming characters, stunning pixel art, and epic music. Follow a grand story set in the mysterious Ocean's End islands full of lost memories, ancient ruins, pirates, treasures, and frogs.

releases.name: Roll Golf
releases.summary:
Tilt the entire course to guide your golf ball through creative obstacles, avoid hazards, and sink the perfect shot across challenging levels.

Discover a fresh take on mini golf where the course is just as important as the ball. Instead of swinging a club, you'll tilt the entire level to guide your golf ball through creative courses filled with ramps, moving platforms, narrow pathways, and clever obstacles.

Use gravity to your advantage as you carefully control the ball's movement, avoid dangerous hazards, and find the perfect route to the hole. Every level introduces new challenges that require precision, timing, and strategic thinking to master.
